templates.source: Avigilon H3-B1 Web Interface User Manual (ManualsLib, manual/833559, p.17) and Avigilon H.264 Series User Manual (ManualsLib, manual/1683537, p.14) — both show example rtsp://admin:admin@192.168.1.79/defaultPrimary?streamType=u; streamType=u = unicast

Avigilon H3-B1 and H.264 Series manuals (ManualsLib, same sources as main): same path, streamType=m selects multicast transport — protocol is selectable as Unicast or Multicast in the camera web UI RTSP configuration page

Avigilon Support Community article 'Access the RTSP Stream or Latest JPEG Image from an H-264 Camera or Encoder' (support.avigilon.com) — documents defaultSecondary as the secondary (sub) stream; confirmed via search engine snippet citing the official KB article. Applies to cameras that support a second stream (not configurable on HDSM 2.0 models).

Avigilon Support Community article 'Access the RTSP Stream or Latest JPEG Image from an H-264 Camera or Encoder' (support.avigilon.com) — documents defaultTertiary for HDSM 2.0 cameras with 4.0 MP and above. Confirmed via search engine snippet citing official KB.

Streamie tutorial 'Tutorial: Avigilon CCTV Video Walls with Streamie' (help.streamieapp.com) cites Avigilon Support document 'Examples of RTSP Stream URI of an Avigilon Multi-sensor Camera' — format is /defaultPrimary-<N>?streamType=u where N=0–3 for up to quad-sensor cameras (e.g. /defaultPrimary-3?streamType=u for 4th sensor). Also confirmed by CamioCam/rtsp GitHub issue #228 showing real-device usage.

unverified_leads.note: No-dash variant — not confirmed in any official Avigilon documentation. The documented multi-sensor format uses a dash: /defaultPrimary-<N>?streamType=u. Likely a StrixCamDB OCR/parsing artifact of the dash form. Excluded.

This is a valid instantiation of the multi-sensor template /defaultPrimary-<N>?streamType=u (N=3 = 4th sensor head). Promoted to templates as multi-sensor-main; retained here only to document the lead was accounted for.

notes: Avigilon (now Motorola Solutions) is a proprietary enterprise IP camera brand with its own RTSP path scheme: /default{Primary|Secondary|Tertiary}?streamType={u|m}. Port 554 is standard. streamType=u is unicast; streamType=m is multicast — selectable in the camera web UI. Secondary/tertiary streams cannot be configured on HDSM 2.0 cameras. Multi-sensor cameras (dual/quad-head models) use /defaultPrimary-<N>?streamType=u with N=0–3 indexing each sensor head; this is documented in Avigilon's own KB article 'Examples of RTSP Stream URI of an Avigilon Multi-sensor Camera'. Codec is H.264 across the H3/H4/H5 product lines covered by these manuals; H.265 support may exist on newer H5A models but is not broken out in the RTSP path — same template applies. Avigilon is NOT an OEM of Dahua/Hikvision/Axis — its path scheme is entirely proprietary. The docs.avigilon.com portal and support.avigilon.com require login for full article text; path confirmation comes from ManualsLib-hosted official Avigilon manuals and search-result snippets of the official KB.
